shared_elements: bird-like creature in profile with long neck or beak
animal or creature in profile placed lower on the surface
figures rendered on a natural stone surface
justification: Both surfaces place a stiff, frontal figure with laterally extended arms as the dominant motif with a smaller profile bird-like creature set below and to one side, which is the only reasonably specific correspondence. Everything else diverges: A is a single thin painted outline on unmodified rock with no framing, while B is a densely carved, multi-register relief pillar with a horizontal patterned band and many distinct animals in modelled, three-dimensional carving.
